# wso2is_userstore (Resource)

Manages a secondary user store. A user store can be a JDBC database, a read-only or read-write LDAP directory, or Active Directory. Users and groups in a secondary user store have the store's domain name as a prefix, for example `CUSTOMERS/alice`. In `wso2is_user`, set `user_store = "CUSTOMERS"`.

The server deploys user stores in the background, and the provider waits until the server reports the change. The provider only manages the property keys in your configuration. To import, use the user store's domain name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_userstore" "customers" {
  name        = "CUSTOMERS"
  type        = "UniqueIDJDBCUserStoreManager"
  description = "Customer accounts"
  properties = {
    url        = "jdbc:postgresql://db.example.com:5432/customers"
    driverName = "org.postgresql.Driver"
    userName   = "wso2"
  }
  secret_properties = {
    password = var.customers_db_password
  }
}

resource "wso2is_user" "customer" {
  username   = "jane"
  user_store = wso2is_userstore.customers.name
  email      = "jane@example.com"
  password   = var.jane_password
}

variable "customers_db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "jane_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Domain name, for example `CUSTOMERS`. Changing it replaces the user store.
- `properties` (Map of String) The user store's properties. A JDBC store needs `url`, `userName` and `driverName` (for example `org.postgresql.Driver`). An LDAP store needs properties such as `ConnectionURL`, `ConnectionName`, `UserSearchBase`, `UserNameAttribute` and `GroupSearchBase`. The Console and `GET /userstores/meta/types/{type-id}` list every property.
- `type` (String) User store manager type: `UniqueIDJDBCUserStoreManager`, `UniqueIDReadOnlyLDAPUserStoreManager`, `UniqueIDReadWriteLDAPUserStoreManager` or `UniqueIDActiveDirectoryUserStoreManager`. Changing it replaces the user store.

### Optional

- `claim_attribute_mappings` (Map of String) User store attribute by local claim URI, for claims that use a different attribute in this user store.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user store is enabled (the `Disabled` property). The default is `true`.
- `secret_properties` (Map of String, Sensitive) Confidential properties, such as `password` for JDBC or `ConnectionPassword` for LDAP. The server returns them encrypted, so the provider cannot notice changes made outside Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User store ID (base64url of the domain name).
- `type_id` (String) Type ID used by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_userstore.customers CUSTOMERS
```
